jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Personalization, DTx Science
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products and solutions are strategically important to enable our Retail and Marketplace businesses to drive long-term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks and break fresh ground in product and technical innovations every day!

Demand Tech Experience (DTx), as an org, owns the Amazon Ads Console — the advertiser-facing workspace for creating and managing campaigns, reviewing performance, and acting on recommendations used by millions of advertisers. Our team, DTx Science, is the centralized science team within DTx, dedicated to improving and protecting the advertiser experience across ad consoles through applied science methodologies. The team drives impact through four core functions: Ad Console Personalization, Recommendation Development, Ad Console Experimentation, and DVA Agent Evaluation and Impact Measurement. We leverage a breadth of state-of-the-art techniques such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, LLMs, long term causal modeling as well as sophisticated A/B testing to develop personalized experiences with directly quantifiable business and advertiser success outcomes. We are looking for an accomplished machine learning expert to lead the Applied Science strategy for our recommendation creation and personalization program.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, stakeholders and cross-functional teams to drive program success through ML-driven solutions. You will shape the applied science roadmap, promote a culture of data-driven decision-making, and deliver significant business impact for millions of advertisers worldwide and the company using advanced data techniques and applied science methodologies.

Key job responsibilities

As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will

Serve as the technical leader in Machine Learning, driving collaboration between scientists and engineers, guiding efforts within the team and collaborating with other teams.
Conduct hands-on analysis and modeling of large-scale data to generate insights that boost ads revenue while maintaining a positive advertiser and shopper experience.
Lead end-to-end Machine Learning projects that involve high levels of ambiguity, scale, and complexity.
Build, experiment, optimize, and deploy machine learning models, collaborating with software engineers to bring your models into production.
Run A/B experiments, gather data, and perform statistical analysis to validate your models.
Develop scalable and automated processes for large-scale data analysis, model development, validation, and serving.
Explore and research innovative machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

About The Team

The DTx Science team is the centralized science team within Demand Tech Experience (DTx), dedicated to improving and protecting the advertiser experience across ad consoles through applied science methodologies. The team drives impact through four core functions: Ad Console Personalization, Recommendation Development, Ad Console Experimentation, and DVA Agent Evaluation and Impact Measurement.

Improve advertiser experience: Ad Console Personalization and Recommendation Development aim to improve the advertiser ad console experience by providing customized and personalized console experiences for each user and increasing their ad performance with relevant, science-backed onboarding and oppertunty recommendations.

Protect advertiser experience: Ad Console Experimentation and DVA Agent Evaluation and Impact Measurement protect the advertiser experience by supporting the organization in making data-driven decisions to launch UX and agentic features that benefit advertisers.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of building models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Agentic AI & Enterprise Solutions

NY/ NJ/ Delaware/ Colombus/ Dallas/ Houston / FL/Chicago/ CA (Hybrid- Onsite)

Contract or Fulltime

Job Description

✅ Must Have

Strong knowledge of AWS, Bedrock and Java is mandatory, Client operates primarily on AWS and Java, this is a key requirement.
Banking domain experience is mandatory.
Minimum 10+ Years experience.

Role Overview

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands on, customer facing engineering leader who bridges business intent and production grade AI solutions. The FDE works directly with business stakeholders, product owners, and platform teams to translate ideas into deployable solutions using an enterprise enabled agentic AI platform and a governed adoption framework.

This role blends solution engineering, AI engineering, and delivery leadership, with strong ownership from problem discovery → architecture → build → deployment → optimization. The FDE operates close to customers and internal product teams, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business outcomes while meeting enterprise, security, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

1️⃣ Idea to Production Solution Delivery

Partner with business stakeholders to understand problem statements, workflows, and desired outcomes
Convert business intent into AI enabled solution designs, agent workflows, and system architectures
Own end to end delivery: prototype → MVP → production rollout
Deploying enterprise complex systems integrations while solving critical business problems
Drive rapid iteration while maintaining enterprise grade quality, security, and reliability

2️⃣ Agentic AI Solution Engineering

Design and implement agentic workflows using enterprise agentic AI platforms
Orchestrate multi agent systems that handle reasoning, planning, execution, validation, and monitoring
Encode business logic, SOPs, policies, and controls into autonomous or semi autonomous agents
Apply human in the loop, guardrails, and fallback mechanisms where required

3️⃣ Frontier Models & Context Engineering

Work with frontier foundation models (LLMs, multimodal models) and enterprise approved model stacks
Perform context engineering:
Prompt design and prompt chaining
Tool grounding and retrieval augmented generation (RAG)
Knowledge graph and memory integration
Optimize solutions for accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability

4️⃣ AI First Engineering & Developer Tooling

Leverage AI assisted development tools to accelerate delivery:
Cursor
GitHub Copilot
AI assisted testing, code review, and refactoring tools
Establish AI augmented engineering workflows across design, build, test, and release phases
Coach teams on effective human AI collaboration in engineering

5️⃣ Intelligent CI/CD & MLOps

Design and implement intelligent CI/CD pipelines integrating:
AI generated code and test artifacts
Policy and control validation
Automated security and compliance checks
Integrate agentic workflows into DevSecOps / MLOps pipelines
Ensure repeatable, auditable, and scalable deployments across environments

6️⃣ Enterprise Readiness & Governance Alignment

Ensure solutions comply with:
Security, privacy, and data handling policies
Model risk management and AI governance frameworks
Regulatory and audit requirements (especially in regulated industries)
Collaborate with platform, security, and governance teams to operationalize guardrails
Contribute patterns, blueprints, and reusable assets to the enterprise AI platform

7️⃣ Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders
Present architectures, demos, and outcomes to engineering leaders, business heads, and executives
Gather feedback from production usage and continuously improve solutions
Serve as the "voice of the customer" back into platform and product teams

️ Required Skills & Experience

Core Engineering & Architecture
Strong background in software engineering (backend, APIs, distributed systems)
Experience building production grade cloud native platforms/applications
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, Go, or similar)
Solid understanding of system design, scalability, and reliability
Skilled in hyperscale platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, OpenShift)

Agentic AI & AI Engineering

Hands on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration patterns (n8n, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, etc.)
Experience working with LLMs / foundation models in enterprise settings (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI)
Strong skills in prompt engineering, context engineering, and tool integration
Understanding of RAG, memory systems, and knowledge grounding
Spec driven development - Architecture, Security and Application frameworks.

⚡ AI Tooling & Productivity

Practical experience using Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding tools
Familiarity with AI assisted testing, documentation, and code review
Ability to design AI first developer workflows

DevOps, CI/CD & Platform Integration

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms
Understanding of DevSecOps and automated control enforcement
Familiarity with MLOps concepts for model lifecycle and monitoring

Enterprise & Soft Skills

Strong problem solving and analytical mindset
Ability to work in ambiguous, fast moving environments
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non technical stakeholders
Customer centric mindset with ownership and accountability
Good handle on Complex enterprise system integrations

⭐ Preferred Qualifications

Experience in regulated industries (banking, financial services, healthcare, etc.)
Exposure to AI governance, model risk, and compliance frameworks
Prior experience in customer facing engineering roles (FDE, Solutions Engineer, Field Engineer)
Experience contributing to platform blueprints, accelerators, or internal frameworks

What Success Looks Like

Business ideas move to production faster and with higher confidence
Agentic AI solutions deliver measurable business outcomes
Engineering teams adopt AI first workflows with strong governance
Customers trust the platform and the FDE as a strategic delivery partner

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to provide technical leadership and architectural direction for artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions supporting a large-scale federal healthcare modernization program.

The AI Architect will be responsible for designing secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and data-driven applications. This individual will work closely with technical leadership, data teams, cloud engineers, application teams, cybersecurity professionals, and government stakeholders to translate mission and business requirements into effective AI architectures.

Key Responsibilities

Define enterprise AI architecture, technical strategy, standards, and solution patterns.
Design scalable AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions for complex healthcare and enterprise use cases.
Lead architecture and technical design activities from proof of concept through production deployment.
Evaluate appropriate AI/ML models, platforms, frameworks, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements.
Design solutions leveraging large language models (LLMs), generative AI, natural language processing, machine learning, and intelligent automation.
Develop architectural approaches for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, knowledge management, and AI-enabled applications.
Design secure integration patterns between AI capabilities, enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and cloud environments.
Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to establish appropriate data architecture for AI solutions.
Provide architectural guidance for MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, frameworks, and technical standards.
Ensure AI solutions meet applicable federal security, privacy, accessibility, data governance, and compliance requirements.
Participate in architecture reviews, technical evaluations, and solution design sessions.
Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to identify and address risks associated with AI implementations.
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to AI/ML engineers, data scientists, developers, and other technical team members.
Communicate complex AI concepts and architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support responsible AI practices, including appropriate governance, transparency, security, and human oversight.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
7+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant experience in enterprise solution or cloud architecture.
Demonstrated experience architecting AI/ML solutions in complex enterprise environments.
Experience designing and implementing machine learning and generative AI solutions.
Strong knowledge of LLMs, NLP, machine learning, data engineering, and modern AI architecture.
Experience with public cloud AI/ML platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Understanding of APIs, microservices, enterprise integration patterns, and distributed architectures.
Experience with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks.
Experience with MLOps, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, and data protection principles.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to meet applicable federal background investigation requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting federal healthcare, health IT, or other large federal programs.
Experience designing AI solutions within highly regulated or security-sensitive environments.
Experience with Azure AI Foundry/Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Experience with generative AI and LLM architectures.
Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector-based retrieval.
Experience with responsible AI and AI governance frameworks.
Experience working with healthcare data and interoperability environments.
Knowledge of FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards is a plus.
Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, APIs, and knowledge management solutions.
Relevant cloud or AI architecture certifications preferred.
Disclaimer: This position is contingent upon ELYON’s receipt of contract award, Government acceptance of the proposed candidate, completion of required onboarding, and continued contract funding.**

Benefits

Paid sick leave, Medical/Dental (optional), 401 (k) Retirement Plan (optional), Employer Paid Life Insurance, Employer Paid Short Term Disability, Optional Life Insurance.

ELYON International, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: ML Technical Lead, Agentic Interactions
jobs.description:
About Sandbar

Sandbar is an interface company in New York City. We aim to augment individuals so we can each think, act, and move more freely. Our team has built SW, ML, and HW products across Meta, CTRL-labs, Google, Apple, Fitbit, Peloton, and Equinox.

Our first product, Stream, is a self extension—a private voice ring and conversational interface. Stream has been featured in WSJ, Bloomberg, & Wired, and begins shipping in Summer '26.

Join us in creating technology that extends human thinking.

About

We're looking for a tech lead to design self-aligned agentic experiences in Stream, and lead the tightly focused team building it. Stream is a self extension, where personalization, privacy, and individual control are paramount.

This is a hands-on lead role for a consumer product, not a platform or research role. You will set the technical direction, build the end-user experience, and be responsible for an that agent works in the hands of general customers. You will work directly with the founders and the backend, iOS, and ML engineers building Stream.

Responsibilities

Lead architecture, strategy, and tradeoffs for our ML-based products
Design and improve user-facing model-based experiences, including agentic control, conversational interactions, and information retrieval.
Develop infrastructure to rapidly develop, evaluate, and deploy models
Optimize inference pipelines for latency, reliability, and concurrency
Work closely with other ML/AI engineers, infrastructure engineers, designers, and cofounders on existing and future products

Qualifications

6+ years in machine learning experience
Experience shipping ML-based products is required
Experience in large-language model evaluation and post-training is required
Experience in audio / voice ML is a plus
Comfortable writing production-grade software
Passion for human-computer interaction
Experience setting technical direction and driving execution with multidisciplinary teams

FTE Benefits

Health, vision, and dental benefits
Company-sponsored 401(k)
Unlimited PTO and sick time
Early stage equity

Compensation Range: $230K - $290K

jobs.title: Government Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation
jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation
: $35–$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective?

At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development.

We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models.

This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions.

Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

The Opportunity

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions.

You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance
Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements
Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing
Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks
Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making
Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations
Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations
Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions
Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios
Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation
Federal, state, or local government procurement processes
Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation
Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance
Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment.
Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations.
Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns.
Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings.
Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning.
Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content.
Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way.

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology.

Contribute to meaningful AI development.

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.

Work remotely with project-based flexibility.

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance.

No AI Background Required.

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading.

Project Details

Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based
Location: Remote, United States only
Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour
Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed
Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities
Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards.

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI?

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above
Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards
Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources
Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines
Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment

Especially Valuable Experience

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

Government Policy or Program Analyst
Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst
Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist
Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer
Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist
RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist
Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst
Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

new_jobs.title: Government Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation
new_jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation
: $35–$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective?

At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development.

We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models.

This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions.

Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

The Opportunity

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions.

You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance
Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements
Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing
Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks
Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making
Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations
Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations
Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions
Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios
Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation
Federal, state, or local government procurement processes
Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation
Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance
Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment.
Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations.
Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns.
Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings.
Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning.
Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content.
Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way.

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology.

Contribute to meaningful AI development.

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.

Work remotely with project-based flexibility.

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance.

No AI Background Required.

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading.

Project Details

Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based
Location: Remote, United States only
Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour
Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed
Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities
Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards.

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI?

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above
Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards
Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources
Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines
Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment

Especially Valuable Experience

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

Government Policy or Program Analyst
Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst
Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist
Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer
Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist
RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist
Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst
Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.
